```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(patchwork))

dt <- read.csv('website.csv')
```

# 1

### (a)

```{r}
p11 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = Budget, y = Visits)) +
    geom_point() + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) 
p11
```


### (b)

```{r}
p12 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = Visits, y = AdType, fill = AdType)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles=c(0.25, .5, .75))
p12
```

Plotted together

```{r}
p11 + p12
```

### (c)

```{r}
mod_budget <- lm(Visits ~ Budget, data = dt)
mod_adtype <- lm(Visits ~ AdType, data = dt)
mod_full <- lm(Visits ~ Budget + AdType, data = dt)

summary(mod_full)
anova(mod_budget, mod_full)
anova(mod_adtype, mod_full)
```

AdType does appear to be significant. Budget does not appear to be significant. 

### (d)

Linearity
```{r}
car::avPlots(mod_full, terms = ~Budget)
```

```{r}
p141 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = (Budget - mean(Budget)), y = (Visits - mean(Visits)))) + 
    geom_point() + 
    labs(x = "Adjusted Budget", y = "Adjusted Visits")
p142 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = fitted(mod_full), y = MASS::stdres(mod_full))) + 
    geom_point()
p143 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = MASS::stdres(mod_full))) + 
    geom_density()

p141 / (p142 + p143)
```


### (e)

```{r}
p151 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = log(Budget), y = Visits)) +
    geom_point() + 
    geom_smooth() 
p152 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = Budget, y = log(Visits))) +
    geom_point() + 
    geom_smooth() 
p153 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = log(Budget), y = log(Visits))) +
    geom_point() + 
    geom_smooth() 
p154 <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = sqrt(Budget), y = log(Visits))) +
    geom_point() + 
    geom_smooth() 


(p151 + p152) / (p153 + p154)
```
